**What happened**

**What you expected**

**Where** — web (browser + version), Android (version), iOS (version), or the feedback service

**Input** — if the OCR output was wrong, attach the image if you can share it, and
paste the text you got alongside the text you expected. Mon text is welcome; the
exact characters matter, since near-miss glyphs are the usual failure.

**Model revision** — shown on the About screen, or `MODEL_VERSION` in the web console
